name: Syzygy: The Hermetic Matrix
tag: A visual way to study the seven Hermetic principles and Gnostic teaching side by side.

scenarios.title: Explore the seven principles
scenarios.ask: Show me {count} of the seven Hermetic principles at {depth} depth.
steps: Lit up {count} principle(s) in the matrix: Mentalism, Correspondence, Vibration, Polarity, Rhythm, Cause and Effect, and Gender.
Explained each one in plain words with an everyday example.
Drew an animated diagram per principle, about {=depth * 4} minutes each.
Added {=count * depth} questions to check your understanding.
followups: The list of seven comes from The Kybalion, published in 1908. The app shows it next to older Hermetic writings, such as the Corpus Hermeticum, so you can compare.
Which principle should I start with?
Most learners start with Correspondence, often summed up as 'as above, so below', because the others build on it.

scenarios.title: Compare Hermetic and Gnostic ideas
scenarios.ask: Compare Hermetic and Gnostic ideas across {texts} texts, about {mins} per text.
steps: Opened {texts} texts, including selections from the Nag Hammadi library found in Egypt in 1945.
Showed syzygies: in Valentinian Gnostic texts, aeons come in paired couples.
Lined up where the traditions agree, such as mind as the source, and where they differ.
Saved your highlights into one study sheet.
followups: In this app it names the paired aeons found in Valentinian Gnostic teaching, and more broadly any pair of opposites shown together in the matrix.
Yes. Each text shows a public translation with notes on difficult words.

scenarios.title: Run a study group
scenarios.ask: Plan a {weeks}-week study group for {people} people on the Hermetic principles.
steps: Spread the seven principles across {weeks} weeks, with {=max(0, weeks - 7)} week(s) for review.
Prepared a shared screen view of the matrix for each meeting.
followups: What if we have fewer than seven weeks?
The planner pairs related principles, such as Polarity and Rhythm, in one meeting.
Yes. Each member gets the matrix, readings and their own notes.
